height-xs.$description: Small link button 'See Detail' (padding 6/8, 12 px label).

height-lg.$description: Outline buttons and large CTAs (Preline _button, padding 14/16).

radius.$description: Every admin and player button (btnPublish, Preline _button and _button-small are all 12).

rim-width.$description: Width of the inner highlight rim on solid buttons.

glow-color.$description: The violet and orchid glow of the primary button, as its blurred blobs average over the button (solved from the Figma render: at 32% on hover it reproduces btnPublish Variant9 within a few values; 5% at rest).

height-md.$description: Search and filter inputs on list pages.

height-lg.$description: Form inputs and selects, measured on the Admin screens (Select Event, the configuration values, Delay Time): 14 px padding around the 19 px line of 15 px text.

gap.$description: Icon to text, label to field.

padding-y.$description: Above and below a multi-line field's text: the form input's own 14 px around its 19 px lines, however many there are (Preline's textarea, of the input's family).

width.$description: Status badges share one width, so a column of them lines up (ACTIVE, COMPLETED, DRAFT, CANCELED).

padding-x.$description: Preline small badge: 3 px padding plus 2.5 px label inset, rounded to the scale.

height.$description: Delta badge in the KPI bar ('+99%'): a pill around SemiBold 14/20 text.

day-size.$description: A day in the date picker (Figma draws no calendar): 40 px, the touch size of the Admin's controls.

day-radius.$description: The corners of a day and of the band ends, as the select's items.

nav-size.$description: The previous and next month buttons.

gap.$description: The month's title to its grid.

height.$description: An active filter under the list toolbar (3409:196594): a blue pill, its 12 px remove icon first, then SemiBold 12/16.
Resource chips: energy, cost, level (Component 9, 24 high).

width.$description: A chip at most: three and their two gaps fill a slider's 260 (Figma Component 9, 81.33 x 24).

list-gap.$description: Between the chips under a decision.

tabs.$description: The underline tabs (_nav-active-link), measured: a 66 px item over its 1 px rule, Poppins 18/27 with 19 px above, 12 px at the sides.

height.$description: The 66 px item and its 1 px rule, which the 2 px active bar covers.

dot-size.$description: The current round's dot: a blue 100 disc with a 6 px blue 800 centre, 8 px after the label.

thumb-size.$description: Preline Range Slider Touch Area Height; its centre never leaves the rail, so the end ticks sit half a thumb in (Figma 832:87599).

marker-offset.$description: From the rail to the ticks (Figma 832:87599: 8).

label-gap.$description: From a tick to its label (Figma 832:87599: 10).

label-gap-sm.$description: The small slider in a decision's column (Figma's 174 px sliders: 4, labels in Regular 12/16, 59 tall).

rail.$description: The rail outside the indigo fill.

width.$description: A decision field's width in the Figma decision row (2097:184137).

check-delay.$description: An entry out of range is checked this long after the last keystroke (today's InputField).

message-duration.$description: A field's message stays this long: it carries a number to read (today's InputField).

message-offset.$description: From the field to its message, which hangs from the field's end edge.

message-max-width.$description: A field's message wraps at this width, or at the room on screen.

hint-duration.$description: After an amount the page refused, the cap stays under a budget field this long (today's BudgetGuardedNumericInput).

width.$description: Figma's switch (Preline _switch, in the hidden Create Simulation row 3286:285607): a 50 x 28 track with 2 px of padding and a 24 px white thumb.

thumb-travel.$description: How far the thumb moves: the width less the thumb and its two insets.

gap.$description: Label to switch (Preline Basic Forms/Switch/Gap Between).

track-off.$description: Off. Figma's track is gray 200 under the white thumb, 1.2:1, where controls need 3:1; gray 500 reads 4.8:1 on white, 4.4:1 on a slate panel, and holds the white thumb at 4.8:1.

gap.$description: The back arrow to the first level's label.

item-gap.$description: Between the levels and the slashes (Figma _breadcrumb).

size-lg.$description: Team card avatar: the Admin team cards and the player sidebar (Figma avatar07, the image alone in a circle).

size-xl.$description: The profile photo in the team's Edit Team Details dialog (Figma 2110:245745).

fallback-delay.$description: How long an image may take before the initials show instead, so a quick image does not flash them.

option-size.$description: The avatar builder's variant tiles: as many to a row as fit, each at least this wide.

crop-mask-spread.$description: How far the photo cropper's dimming reaches from the circle: past every edge of the cropper, which clips it.
